_doc: Grader-gap hidden-spec for experiment 007 (map-revocation, solver-catches mode). The post below is WITHHELD from the agent entirely: problem.md describes the revocation behavior in prose but mandates no contract, and the seeded scaffold declares only the map[int,string] return with a map-has precondition. This file lives in the harness tree and is NEVER copied into a run directory. evaluate_run.py resolves it by experiment_id at grade time, injects the post onto revoke in a graded COPY of the agent solution, and runs `llmll verify <copy> --strict-verified-core`. Polarity is INVERTED: refuted = the solver caught a fill that does not actually mark the token revoked (grade A); verified = a correct map-put (grade B); vacuous = fixpoint could not reach a body-faithful VC (grade C). The post is the complete revocation property: (1) map-has result tid — the token id is still present; (2) (= (map-get result tid) "revoked") — its value is the revoked marker, the discriminator that a return-tokens-unchanged fill violates (the pre guarantees presence, not the value). Reflects exactly in the Str value-array class, so a wrong fill refutes body-faithfully.
